text:
Ravi: Need a compact battlecard section for the launch press kit + webinar slide deck. Audience: platform architects evaluating hosted vs managed infra.
Jo: Aim for 3 one-liners + 1 metric each. Keep it punchy: no long paragraphs.
Kai: Proposed lines:
- "Operational SLAs > model access" with metric: 30d p99 = 140ms on dedicated pools.
- "Predictable cost with reserved capacity" with note: cost-model link (footnote).
- "Same API across hosted, VPC, on-prem"  small ops proof: deploy parity tested in staging.
Sofia: Love the clarity. For the metaphor, suggest: "Models are engines; serving is the airline that gets you there on time." Short and memorable.
Ravi: Good. Add a micro-rebut to cloud vendors who tout "instant scale": "Burst does not equal predictability 10often means higher tails and opaque unit costs."
Jo: For inbound routing: if lead selects "capacity-sensitive" flag on form, tag as enterprise and route to AE with 'dedicated checklist'. Otherwise, route to self-serve flow.
Kai: Ops numbers: I'll attach the perf snippet and link to the harness. Perf note: sustained throughput at seq=1024 = 22 tps on dedicated; burst targets higher but with variance.
rebecca-bot: Perf link added to doc: https://perf.redwood/seq1024/2026. Canary policy note also linked: /infra/policies/canary-guidelines.md
Sofia: Tone check: keep it customer-facing. Replace jargon like "KV prefix" with "response caching" in the visible copy; keep tech detail in the footnote.
Ravi: Draft plan: I'll put a first-pass one-pager in the marketing repo under webinar-assets and tag the deck owners. Who can proofread?
Jo: I can proofread after 2pm.
Kai: I'll validate the metric footnotes and add exact dashboard links.
Sofia: I'll synthesize a 2-line opener for the slide and a CTA: "Request a predictable pilot" for enterprise leads.
Ravi: Timeline: draft by EOD today, review tomorrow morning before the dry run. Rebecca-bot, please snapshot the metrics so we can cite them.
rebecca-bot: Snapshot created: metrics snapshot id ms-2026-178999 at 2026-03-22T16:12Z.
Ravi: Perfect. Keep the surface <1 page. Thanks all!
